d: We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive Project Research Analyst to join our Research, Business Analysis & Project Management team in Bahrain.

As an IT services and digital marketing company, MEGAZ SOLUTION focuses on delivering innovative digital solutions, supporting business development initiatives, and improving project performance through effective research and data-driven decision-making.
Conduct market research, industry analysis, and competitor research to identify emerging business trends, market opportunities, and potential project developments.
Collect, evaluate, and analyse business data, project information, and market intelligence to support management decision-making.
Research potential projects, business partnerships, clients, and investment opportunities across relevant industries.
Prepare detailed research reports, project proposals, presentations, and analytical documentation for management review.
Evaluate project feasibility, operational requirements, potential risks, estimated costs, and expected business outcomes.
Collaborate with Project Management, IT, Marketing, Business Development, and Operations teams to support project planning and execution.
Monitor project developments, industry trends, and performance indicators, providing regular updates and recommendations to management.
Identify opportunities for business improvement, process optimization, and strategic development through research findings and data analysis.
Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Project Management, Research, or a related discipline.
1 to 3 years of relevant experience in market research, project analysis, business analysis, or research coordination.
Previous experience in IT services, digital marketing, business consulting, project management, or technology-related industries will be an advantage.
Proficient in Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Familiarity with Power BI, data visualization, and research tools is an advantage.
Good understanding of market research methodologies, business analysis, project evaluation, data interpretation, and report preparation.
Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple research assignments and meet deadlines.
Ability to work independently, conduct detailed research, and present findings clearly and professionally.
Annual performance bonuses and salary reviews based on individual contributions and company performance.
Annual leave, medical insurance, and applicable employment benefits in accordance with Bahrain Labour Law.

Professional development opportunities, business research training, analytical skills development, and career advancement opportunities into Senior Project Research Analyst, Business Research Analyst, Project Analyst, or Research & Strategy Manager roles.
